def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    p=None; g=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']<=10:
            b=n['boundary']; p=(min(x[0] for x in b),min(x[1] for x in b))
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; g.append((min(x[0] for x in b),min(x[1] for x in b)))
    return p, sorted(g)
print("before LEFT", state())
r=action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT", state(), "changed", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
# Did greens move just from LEFT?
print("step", current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
